failureMessage: the vendored canon is refreshed nightly and refactored upstream — code that reaches into it inherits every canon rename as a breaking change
fix: inline the few lines you need into your own tree, remove the reference, or accept it with a reason in .claudinite-checks.json (rule "claudinite-isolation")

forbidReferences.reason: consumer files must not couple to the vendored canon — the wiring files are the reviewed exceptions (vendoring/DESIGN.md)

failureMessage: the scheduler is the repo's only cron and its slot math anchors on the hour — a drifted cron or a missing guard silently breaks staggering, double-run safety, or manual runs

countMatchingLines.what: declares {count} cron schedules, expected exactly one
countMatchingLines.fix: keep a single hourly cron — the scheduler is the repo's only cron

matchLines.what: {match} is not hourly on a fixed minute in :10–:50
matchLines.fix: use "<minute> * * * *" with a minute from 10 to 50 (bootstrap assigns it) — other crons collide with the :00 stampede or break the hourly slot math

checkEachFile.fix: add workflow_dispatch: so the scheduler can be run manually
add a concurrency: group so overlapping runs serialize (double-run safety)

checkEachFile.what: does not run the vendored engine entry
checkEachFile.fix: the job must run the vendored engine — node .claudinite/shared/engine/scheduler/run.mjs (slot dispatch) or .../queue/tick.mjs (queue dispatch); all logic lives in the engine, not the workflow
set permissions.contents: write — the update runner pushes its delivery branch; without it the self-refresh 403s
set permissions.pull-requests: write — the update runner opens its PR and arms auto-merge; without it the PR create 403s

failureMessage: the precondition is the ONLY decision point — a later-phase skip hides work from the run records and re-litigates a verdict already given

matchLines.what: instructs a conditional skip after the precondition already passed: "{match}"
matchLines.fix: move the run/no-run decision into the task.mjs precondition — or, if the work ran and found nothing, reword it as an empty outcome, not a decision to skip

matchLines.what: prework announces a discretionary cycle skip: "{match}"
matchLines.fix: let the precondition make that call, or complete the work and report an empty outcome; only a genuine failure may stop a run past the precondition

failureMessage: core carries Claudinite's own rules — the mount, the declaration, adoption, the update and the task contract — a member that does not declare it runs the machinery with none of them

checkParsedFiles.what: does not declare the mandatory "core" pack
checkParsedFiles.fix: add "core" to "packs" — it is basics' own dependency, so the requires closure writes it back the next time the declaration is written
